Sofia Ramos: Flagging Meridian Tech (midmarket). Usage dropped ~58% after a failed import. Trial billing not set, ends in 13 days. Thinking of a 'downgrade cushion + re-engage' play to avoid hard churn.

Eli Turner: what do you mean by cushion?

Sofia Ramos: offer a temporary downgrade to a free 'cushion' tier that preserves workspace and data for 30 days, plus a short enablement lab to unblock the import. Low-friction, low-cost.

Jae Kim: nice. Steps? cadence?

Sofia Ramos: plan: 1) Outreach: empathetic email offering cushion + booking link. 2) Auto-provision 1.5k token credit when they accept. 3) 25-min lab focused on CSV mapping + a 1-click test. 4) Capture two quick poll answers in session: main blocker + intent to continue. 5) Events: `cushion_activated`, `csv_test_passed`, `reactivation_optin`.

BillingOps: approve credits up to 2000 tokens per case. Need claim flow.

Eli Turner: I'll wire the portal flag for cushion state and on-reply trigger. Also add the GIF walkthrough to the booking confirmation.

Jae Kim: templates: (A) cushion offer, (B) reactivation nudge. I'll draft both and add a short rubric when to use cushion vs pause vs full save.

cs-bot: Reminder: Calendly link missing for Meridian Tech (assigned to Jae Kim).

Sofia Ramos: draft email snippet: 
``
Hi {{first_name}},
We noticed activity dropped. We can move you to a temporary cushion tier for 30 days to preserve your workspace while we help finish the import. Book a 25-min lab here: {{calendly}} or reply "CUSHION" to accept. We'll include a small token credit to validate the fix.
``

Eli Turner: instrumentation note: emit events with account id. If `csv_test_passed` fires, auto-schedule a health 1:1 in 48h.

Jae Kim: pushing templates and Calendly now. Will tag Product to verify reply->flag automation.

Sofia Ramos: sending outreach today. Will post booking and results here. :rocket: 

Sofia Ramos: update 1789012460 - Meridian replied and booked the lab for Thu 3pm. Running play and will update with outcome.
